metric_scope.cer_wer: 19855 unambiguous references, excluding 231 wildcard labels; CER includes internal spaces.
metric_scope.dev: Independent OCR dev1655 and general dev1200; English guard uses 200 TextVQA and 200 A-OKVQA examples.
metric_scope.five: 8798 examples across five complete benchmarks; primary metrics as specified in benchmark CSV.
metric_scope.official_kstr: 20086 released public KAIST-Corrected/GIST-Signboard crops; official upstream wildcard and whitespace rules; AIHub excluded.

public_data_policy: Only numeric metrics, optimizer steps, counts, source hashes and public run URLs. No sample IDs, image references, transcriptions, labels, prompts, private absolute paths or secrets.
training_window_aggregation: Exact immutable W&B train events: sum/count means for counted metrics, last for scalar metrics; 10 updates except final partial window.

grpo.comparison: Every event identity and every published metric value, exact equality.

sft.comparison: Every event identity and every published metric value, exact equality.

wandb_reconciliation_source: Existing verified read-only receipt; no new query
